name: Dirk van der Meer
bio: Dirk's fascination with motorsport began at a young age, tinkering with his father's old kart in their garage. He pursued a degree in aerospace engineering, focusing on aerodynamics, which naturally led him to wind tunnel technology. After graduating, he gained valuable experience at a smaller racing outfit before joining Target Racing. Dirk is known for his meticulous approach, ensuring every test run is conducted with the highest precision. He believes in data-driven decisions and constantly seeks ways to refine the team's aerodynamic package. His pragmatic nature helps him quickly identify critical areas for improvement, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Dirk has a lean build and a focused expression, often seen with a pen behind his ear.

quirks: Always calibrates equipment twice before starting a test.
Drinks black coffee with exactly one sugar cube.
Organizes his tools by size and function every morning.
